import ast, contextlib, datetime, hashlib, io, json, platform, re, subprocess, tarfile
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from tiny_perceptron.modern import DenseFFN
from tiny_perceptron.model import ModelConfig, TinyLM
from scripts.course_experiments.common import split_records, records_sha256, text_examples

root = Path.cwd()
artifact = root / "docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/omni-p6-wave04-15.1/verification-v1.json"
cache = Path("/workspace/work/reference/omni-p6-wave04-15.1")
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
freeze_path = "docs/course-revision-20261029-omni/reviews/P5-actual/source-freeze-v18.json"
freeze = json.loads((root / freeze_path).read_bytes())
page = next(p for p in freeze["pages"] if p["page_id"] == "15.1")
raw = (root / page["snapshot"]).read_bytes()
assert sha(raw) == page["source_sha256"] == "08209b8a0bcb4586de9d24243c264bcf5dba65b6d7705edd7a02fa9b1ea85f87"
text = raw.decode("utf-8")
inline = re.search(r"```python\n(.*?)```", text, re.S).group(1)
def run_snippet(snippet):
    namespace = {}
    stream = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stream):
        exec(compile(snippet, "<frozen-15.1-inline>", "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace, stream.getvalue()
base, base_stdout = run_snippet(inline)
up, down, x = (base[k] for k in ("up", "down", "x"))
expected = [[4., 5.], [5., 4.]]
assert base["ffn"](x).tolist() == expected
assert base["ffn"](torch.cat([x, x], dim=0)).tolist() == expected * 2
weights_before = (up.clone(), down.clone(), up.data_ptr(), down.data_ptr())
triple_code = inline.replace("torch.cat([x, x], dim=0)", "torch.cat([x, x, x], dim=0)")
triple, triple_stdout = run_snippet(triple_code)
assert len(triple["batch"]) == 6 and triple["ffn"](triple["batch"]).tolist() == expected * 3
negative_code = triple_code.replace("[[1.0, 2.0], [2.0, 1.0]]", "[[1.0, -2.0], [2.0, 1.0]]")
negative, negative_stdout = run_snippet(negative_code)
negative_pre = negative["x"] @ negative["up"]
negative_post = torch.relu(negative_pre)
assert negative_pre[0].tolist() == [1., -2., -1.]
assert negative_post[0].tolist() == [1., 0., 0.]
assert negative["ffn"](negative["x"])[0].tolist() == [1., 0.]
assert torch.equal(up, weights_before[0]) and torch.equal(down, weights_before[1])
assert (up.data_ptr(), down.data_ptr()) == weights_before[2:]
# Ordinary FFN weights use the transpose convention of the hand-written tables.
linear_up = torch.nn.Linear(2, 3, bias=False)
linear_down = torch.nn.Linear(3, 2, bias=False)
with torch.no_grad():
    linear_up.weight.copy_(up.T)
    linear_down.weight.copy_(down.T)
    assert torch.equal(linear_down(torch.relu(linear_up(x))), base["ffn"](x))
small = DenseFFN(2, hidden=3)
assert small.activation == "gelu"
assert sum(p.numel() for p in small.parameters()) == 17
assert sum(p.numel() for p in (small.up.bias, small.down.bias)) == 5

result_path = root / "docs/course-experiments/results/moe.json"
report = json.loads(result_path.read_bytes())
v = report["results"]["variants"]["dense_active_top1"]
cfg = ModelConfig(**v["model"]["config"])
# Construct and count only. No training, model forward, weights load, or evaluation.
model = TinyLM(cfg)
counts = {name: p.numel() for name, p in model.named_parameters()}
assert sum(counts.values()) == 141568 == v["model"]["parameters"]
ffn_counts = [sum(p.numel() for p in block.ffn.parameters()) for block in model.blocks]
assert ffn_counts == [33088, 33088]
assert [block.ffn.up.out_features for block in model.blocks] == [256, 256]
heldout = {}
for split, displayed in [("validation", "2.29999"), ("test", "2.32093")]:
    z = v["heldout"][split]
    recomputed = z["nll_sum"] / z["effective_tokens"]
    assert recomputed == z["nll"] and f"{recomputed:.5f}" == displayed
    heldout[split] = {k: z[k] for k in ["nll", "nll_sum", "effective_tokens", "examples", "records"]}
    heldout[split]["recomputed_nll"] = recomputed
    heldout[split]["rounded_5dp"] = f"{recomputed:.5f}"
assert v["training"]["optimizer_updates"] == v["training"]["steps"] == 180
assert v["training"]["skipped_updates"] == 0
assert len(report["results"]["variants"]) == 7

archive = root / "assets/training/tinystories-v1.tar.gz"
with tarfile.open(archive, "r:gz") as tf:
    member = next(m for m in tf.getmembers() if m.name.endswith("tinystories-train-512.jsonl"))
    dataset_raw = tf.extractfile(member).read()
records = [json.loads(line) for line in dataset_raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines()]
assert len(records) == 512
assert sha(dataset_raw) == "7aa55a657de6499be64a513aa76eb21a9cd52276bf836ba725e1d7f52ea511e0"
upstream = (cache / "TinyStories-train-first-458752.bin").read_bytes()
upstream_stories = upstream.decode("utf-8").split("<|endoftext|>")[:-1][:512]
assert len(upstream_stories) == 512
assert [r["text"] for r in records] == [t.strip() for t in upstream_stories]
for r in records:
    r["family"] = r.get("text_sha256", records_sha256([{"text": r["text"]}]))
splits = split_records(records, report["seed"])
dataset_check = {}
for name, rows in splits.items():
    examples = text_examples(rows, max_length=cfg.max_length)
    effective = sum(int((y != -100).sum()) for _, y in examples)
    actual = {"records": len(rows), "sha256": records_sha256(rows)}
    assert actual == report["results"]["dataset"][name]
    if name in heldout:
        assert effective == heldout[name]["effective_tokens"]
        assert len(examples) == heldout[name]["examples"]
    dataset_check[name] = {**actual, "effective_targets": effective, "chunk_examples": len(examples)}
family_sets = {k: {r["family"] for r in rows} for k, rows in splits.items()}
assert not (family_sets["train"] & family_sets["validation"] or family_sets["train"] & family_sets["test"] or family_sets["validation"] & family_sets["test"])

revision = report["revision"]
p = "scripts/course_experiments/architecture.py"
old = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{revision}:{p}"])
assert sha(old) == report["code_sha256"][p]
old_defs = {n.name: n for n in ast.parse(old).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
new_defs = {n.name: n for n in ast.parse((root / p).read_bytes()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
functions = ["_description", "_clone_config", "_text_dataset", "_data_report", "_steps", "_forward", "_nll", "_train", "_heldout", "run_moe"]
function_comparison = {}
for name in functions:
    equal = ast.dump(old_defs[name], include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(new_defs[name], include_attributes=False)
    assert equal
    function_comparison[name] = {"AST_equal": equal, "original_lines": [old_defs[name].lineno, old_defs[name].end_lineno]}
code_hashes = {}
for name in ["tiny_perceptron/modern.py", "tiny_perceptron/model.py", "tiny_perceptron/attention.py", "tiny_perceptron/data.py", "scripts/course_experiments/common.py"]:
    digest = sha((root / name).read_bytes())
    assert digest == report["code_sha256"][name]
    code_hashes[name] = digest
plan = json.loads((root / "docs/course-experiments/plan.json").read_bytes())
spec = next(p for p in plan["sequence"] if p["id"] == "moe")
assert spec["module"] == "architecture" and spec["function"] == "run_moe"
# Resolve the cited CLI without running an experiment, and check the linked table.
import sys
help_result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.course_experiments.run", "--help"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
assert "--experiment" in help_result.stdout
assets_result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "scripts.course_experiments.run", "--list-assets", "moe"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
assert "assets/training/tinystories-v1.tar.gz" in assets_result.stdout
chapter = (root / "course/chapters/15.md").read_text()
table_section = re.search(r"^## 15\.13 .*?(?=^## |\Z)", chapter, re.M | re.S).group(0)
for variant in report["results"]["variants"].values():
    for split in ["validation", "test"]:
        assert f"{variant['heldout'][split]['nll']:.5f}" in table_section
for target_count in ["39,256", "41,914"]:
    assert target_count in table_section
training_page = (root / "course/training.md").read_text()
assert 'id="fixed-moe-recipe"' in training_page and "--experiment moe" in training_page
result = {
    "executed_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "environment": {"python": platform.python_version(), "torch": str(torch.__version__), "torch_git": str(torch.version.git_version), "device": "cpu"},
    "freeze": {"path": freeze_path, "sha256": sha((root / freeze_path).read_bytes()), "snapshot": page["snapshot"], "snapshot_bytes": len(raw), "source_sha256": sha(raw), "figure_sha256": page["figures_sha256"]},
    "inline": {"code": inline, "stdout": base_stdout, "dtype": str(up.dtype), "up_shape": list(up.shape), "down_shape": list(down.shape), "up_numel": up.numel(), "down_numel": down.numel(), "hidden": (x @ up).tolist(), "relu_hidden": torch.relu(x @ up).tolist(), "output": base["ffn"](x).tolist(), "repeated_shape": list(base["batch"].shape), "same_weights_after_cat": True},
    "triple_exercise": {"stdout": triple_stdout, "rows": len(triple["batch"]), "parameters": triple["up"].numel() + triple["down"].numel()},
    "negative_exercise": {"stdout": negative_stdout, "first_pre_relu": negative_pre[0].tolist(), "first_post_relu": negative_post[0].tolist(), "first_output": negative["ffn"](negative["x"])[0].tolist()},
    "DenseFFN_2_3": {"activation": small.activation, "parameters_with_bias": 17, "bias_parameters": 5, "linear_transpose_equivalence": True},
    "parameter_count": {"config": v["model"]["config"], "by_parameter": counts, "per_layer_ffn": ffn_counts, "total": sum(counts.values())},
    "preserved_result": {"path": str(result_path.relative_to(root)), "sha256": sha(result_path.read_bytes()), "revision": revision, "recorded_environment": {k: report[k] for k in ["device", "seed", "torch_version", "python_version", "gpu"]}, "optimizer_updates": v["training"]["optimizer_updates"], "skipped_updates": v["training"]["skipped_updates"], "training_effective_targets": v["training"]["effective_tokens"], "heldout": heldout, "variant_names": list(report["results"]["variants"])},
    "raw_dataset": {"archive": str(archive.relative_to(root)), "archive_sha256": sha(archive.read_bytes()), "member": member.name, "member_sha256": sha(dataset_raw), "upstream_prefix_sha256": sha(upstream), "first_512_texts_match_original_upstream": True, "splits": dataset_check, "family_overlap": False},
    "historical_code": {"revision": revision, "path": p, "sha256": sha(old), "current_sha256": sha((root / p).read_bytes()), "relevant_functions": function_comparison, "other_run_code_sha256_matched": code_hashes},
    "recipe_resolution": {"plan_id": spec["id"], "module": spec["module"], "function": spec["function"], "executed_training_recipe": False, "help_command_returncode": help_result.returncode, "list_assets_stdout": assets_result.stdout, "all_seven_heldout_rows_and_denominators_found_in_15_13": True, "T8_anchor_and_moe_option_found": True},
    "scope": "Verbatim frozen inline and both modifications on synthetic CPU tensors; model construction/count only; preserved raw JSON arithmetic; 512-story prefix and split/token recomputation. No model training, historical model forward, teacher forward, weights download, GPU, Modal, paid compute, publication, or evaluation rerun. Recorded losses are inspected preserved results, not freshly reproduced measurements."
}
record = json.loads(artifact.read_bytes())
record["execution"] = result
artifact.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"status": "all_assertions_passed", "artifact": str(artifact.relative_to(root)), "inline_stdout": base_stdout, "triple_rows": len(triple["batch"]), "negative_first": result["negative_exercise"]["first_output"], "ffn_parameters": ffn_counts, "total_parameters": sum(counts.values()), "validation": heldout["validation"], "test": heldout["test"], "dataset": dataset_check}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

import torch

up = torch.tensor([[1.0, 0.0, 1.0], [0.0, 1.0, 1.0]])
down = torch.tensor([[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0], [1.0, 1.0]])


def ffn(x):
    return torch.relu(x @ up) @ down


x = torch.tensor([[1.0, 2.0], [2.0, 1.0]])
for batch in (x, torch.cat([x, x], dim=0)):
    print("輸出", ffn(batch).tolist())
    print("token數", len(batch), "權重數", up.numel() + down.numel())
